messages.subject: Heatmap of DMRs in methylKit
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,

I am using methylKit to identify DMRs in RRBS data. Is it possible to create a heatmap for the identified DMRs in methylKit?
A heatmap of the DMRs would be perfect to visualise the methylation patterns between control and treatment group.

Thank you.

Best,
Geetha

messages.subject_clean: Input file format in methylkit package
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

This my first time using the methylkit package. I have a bed file output from bsmap consisting of chr, start, end, methylation ratio, coverage but the
strand is split by coverage (eg. 36 sites split into 31 on + strand and 5 on –
strand). So how can I prepare the strand column for methylkit read function? Has anyone encounter this issue or I can prepare the input file without strand information, is it going to work?

messages.subject: mincov in bedgraph()
messages.body_plain:
Dear Altuna,

Is there any mincov filtration in bedgraph(). I have converted meth file to bedgraph but I think it is considering mincov =10. I could not find any parameter of mincov in bedgraph()

I am attaching a screenshot from IGV where I am comparing (please look labels on left side) bedgraphs from bismark and methykit.

Here are commands as well.

test.cpg.call= methRead("cpg_files/test.txt",sample.id <http://sample.id>="test",assembly="hg38",context="CpG")

bedgraph(sperm.cpg.call,file.name <http://file.name> = "sperm1.bedgraph" ,col.name <http://col.name> = "perc.meth",unmeth = FALSE, log.transform = FALSE, negative = FALSE, add.on = "")

Thanks in advance, looking for a response :)

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] mincov in bedgraph()
messages.body_plain:
you can filter the methylKit object with the coverage threshold you want and then call bedgraph. you can use the [ ] notation like you would use in a data frame to filter rows based on values of a column.

Best,
Altuna

messages.subject_clean: Error in reading files for methylkit package with methRead function
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I have a text file with the below mentioned heading:
Chrom.Pos    Chrom    Pos    Avg     Methratio    Coverage    Strand
chr1.5332          chr1    5332  0.75          -1.0             12               +
chr1.25607         chr1   25607 0.7            -1.0            10               +
chr1.25761         chr1   25761 0.46           -1.0            28              +
chr1.35776         chr1   35776 1.0               1.0           13               +

When I was reading the file I am getting the following error:
myobj=methRead("YC1_3498.txt",sample.id <http://sample.id>="YC",assembly="rn6",header=TRUE, context="CpG", resolution="base",
+          pipeline=list(fraction=TRUE,chr.col=2,start.col=3,end.col=3,
+                        coverage.col=6,strand.col=7,freqC.col=5))
Received single location.
Reading file.
|--------------------------------------------------|
|==================================================|
|--------------------------------------------------|
|==================================================|
Error in round(data[, coverage.col]) :
  non-numeric argument to mathematical function

Question1: How can I remove -1.0 values from methratio column since these are missing values.
Question2: Why am I getting this error?
Question3: I have 3 different conditions with each having control and treatment groups including 3 replicates so how can I read the files using system.file function? For example: Y, M, A are 3 different conditions with control & treatment groups as YC and YT. YC has 3 replicates and YT has 3 replicates. Same applies for M and A groups.

Please help and reply asap because I am stuck here since 1 week.

Thanks,
Puja
